_about: Solana settlement rails. One launch chain. settleable.ts re-checks every mint on-chain (owner program, decimals, freeze authority via getMultipleAccounts) and quotes depth through Jupiter's swap quote at $1K / $10K / $50K / $250K in USDC, so an entry here is a claim it will test, not a fact it trusts. Mint addresses come from CoinGecko's platform map or the issuer's own docs — never typed from memory.

Solana.note: Solana mainnet-beta. Tokens are SPL Token or Token-2022 mints (tokenized stocks and Kalshi outcome tokens are Token-2022). Depth is Jupiter's aggregated route across Raydium, Meteora, Orca, Byreal and the RFQ venues; priceImpactPct is Jupiter's own figure for the route. Public RPC is rate-limited; the scripts batch 100 mints per call and pace requests.

aliases._about: registry ticker -> the Solana mint that settles it. BTC settles as cbBTC (Coinbase-custodied wrapped BTC, native Solana mint); ETH as Wormhole-wrapped ETH; the COMEX gold row GC as XAUT0 (Tether Gold, omnichain via LayerZero, redeemable for LBMA bars).

classRules._about: Rows with no hand entry fall through to these, so the reason is legible on the row.

stocks:Backed xStocks.note: xStock (Backed Assets (JE) Ltd; Token-2022, 8 dec). Fully backed tracker certificates; secondary trading on Solana is permissionless, primary issuance is KYC'd and ex-US. Depth is Jupiter's route (Raydium CLMM, Byreal, Riptide, BinaryFi…).

stocks:Ondo Global Markets.gate: primary: mint/redeem at NAV through the Ondo Stocks API (attestation-signed, whitelisted non-US address); Jupiter shows no route for most tickers
stocks:Ondo Global Markets.note: Ondo Global Markets token (Ondo Global Markets (BVI) Ltd; Token-2022, 9 dec). 1:1 backed structured notes, Chainlink price feeds, daily attestations. Liquidity is primary — the protocol would source from the issuer, so secondary depth is the wrong gate.

predictions.as: Kalshi YES / NO outcome token (Token-2022, minted by DFlow)
predictions.venue: Kalshi order book via DFlow CLP
predictions.note: Every Kalshi market is reachable as a Solana SPL pair through DFlow's Prediction Markets API: a /order from USDC to the YES or NO mint tokenizes the market on first trade if it is not already initialized. Pre-minted yesMint/noMint addresses come from the DFlow metadata API (production key). Winning tokens redeem for USDC after resolution.

commodities.note: futures contract; no token exists on any chain. Gold settles as XAUT0 (alias) and the GLD / SLV / PPLT / PALL tokenized ETFs sit on the Stocks shelf.

crypto.note: no Solana mint on CoinGecko's platform map for this asset

currencies.note: no Jupiter-verified stablecoin for this currency on peg over the $1M floor yet — spot only, shown like a CME contract (build-registry.ts names the largest on-peg mint under the floor on the row)

thresholds._about: price impact is Jupiter's priceImpactPct for the route, as a fraction. Rows under minLiqToQuote of pooled liquidity (Jupiter price v3) are marked thin without a quote.
